[SWS_DM_01393] SOVD method Get the Status of an Operation Execution
⌈
For each DiagnosticRoutine with DiagnosticRequestRou-
tineResults the SOVD Server Instance shall provide the SOVD method Get the
Status of an Operation Execution according to SOVD SOVD[2]. The Diag-
nostic Server instance shall execute the method analog to Service RoutineCon-
trol (0x31) with RequestResults (0x03) of ISO 14229-1[1] using the same instance of
the processing mechanism.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01393] Support of SOVD method Read the Status of an Opera- tion Execution
⌈
For each DiagnosticSovdOperationGetStatus, the Diagnostic Server
instance shall provide the SOVD method Read the Status of an Operation
Execution according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
